### subject_definitions

<Subject 1> is the woman in <Picture 1>, wearing a blue dress.

<Subject 2> is the man in <Picture 2>, wearing white clothes.

### summary

A 15-second, 16:9, 4K, 24fps photorealistic live-action theatrical action-comedy short.

At night inside a luxurious modern penthouse, <Subject 1> attacks and chases <Subject 2>, while <Subject 2> mainly evades her and playfully annoys her.

The central gag is five very brief cheek kisses, all initiated exclusively by <Subject 2>.

**<Subject 1> strongly rejects every kiss. She never participates in, reciprocates, or welcomes any kiss. During every kiss attempt, her mouth stays naturally closed. She does not pucker, pout, purse her lips, lean toward <Subject 2>, close her eyes in anticipation, or make any kissing expression. Instead, she visibly pulls her face away, turns her head aside, leans backward, raises a hand to push him away, or immediately recoils after the kiss. Her facial expression shows surprise, annoyance, and rejection.**

**The visual action must always communicate: <Subject 2> moves toward <Subject 1>; <Subject 1> moves away from him or pushes him away. Never reverse this relationship.**

After every kiss, <Subject 2> immediately retreats.

The action is fast, continuous, playful, pre-choreographed, and physically believable.

For the ending, <Subject 1> runs ahead and <Subject 2> chases her from behind. They must not run side by side or parallel to each other.

No anime, game-like CG, cheap VFX, slow motion, fake slow motion, fear, threat, coercion, or deadly combat.

### retention_analysis

#### Visual Reference Retention

* <Subject 1> — fully_preserved from <Picture 1>.
* <Subject 2> — fully_preserved from <Picture 2>.
* <Picture 1> — reference for <Subject 1>.
* <Picture 2> — reference for <Subject 2>.

#### Performance Retention

* <Subject 1>'s attacks and pursuit — fully_preserved.
* <Subject 2>'s evasive and playful movement — fully_preserved.
* Five brief cheek-kiss beats initiated exclusively by <Subject 2> — fully_preserved.
* <Subject 1>'s visible rejection of every kiss — fully_preserved.
* <Subject 1> never reciprocates or makes a kissing expression — fully_preserved.
* Final front-and-back chase with <Subject 1> running ahead and <Subject 2> chasing from behind — fully_preserved.

#### Audio Retention

* Four Korean dialogue lines — fully_copy.
* Action and kiss sounds — partially_copy.
* Penthouse ambience — reference.
* Background score — reference.

### detailed_description

[Shot 1] <Subject 1> attacks <Subject 2> rapidly in the penthouse living room with a punch, spinning attack, and kick. <Subject 2> quickly evades without seriously counterattacking.

<Subject 1> is the attacker. <Subject 2> is the evasive prankster.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, <Subject 2> suddenly moves toward <Subject 1> and initiates a very brief kiss on her right cheek.

**<Subject 1> does not lean toward him. She keeps her lips naturally closed, turns her face slightly away, recoils from him, and raises a hand as if pushing him away. She looks surprised and annoyed rather than cooperative.**

The camera smoothly pushes in during the same continuous movement to clearly show <Subject 2> initiating the kiss and <Subject 1>'s rejecting reaction.

<Subject 1> says: <d>[Korean] 야!</d>

<Subject 2> immediately retreats.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, <Subject 1> angrily chases and attacks <Subject 2> with a low sweep and high kick.

<Subject 2> ducks and escapes past her.

[Shot 4] At 00:05.500, <Subject 2> approaches from the opposite side and initiates the second brief kiss on <Subject 1>'s left cheek.

**<Subject 1> clearly tries to avoid the kiss. Her lips remain closed and relaxed. She turns her head away and slightly pulls her upper body backward while pushing <Subject 2> away with one hand. She does not pucker or reciprocate.**

The camera smoothly pushes in to show the kiss and her immediate rejection.

<Subject 2> says: <d>[Korean] 또 실패.</d>

He immediately retreats.

[Shot 5] At 00:07.000, <Subject 1> continues pursuing <Subject 2> through the living room toward the corridor, using rapid punches, kicks, and a spinning attack.

<Subject 2> continuously dodges and retreats.

[Shot 6] At 00:09.000, <Subject 2> suddenly closes in and initiates the third brief cheek kiss.

**<Subject 1> reacts by turning her face away from him and pulling backward. Her mouth stays completely closed. She does not pucker, pout, lean toward him, close her eyes romantically, or cooperate with the kiss. Her expression is clearly irritated and resistant.**

There is no dialogue.

<Subject 2> immediately retreats with an intentionally provocative but playful expression.

[Shot 7] At 00:10.500, <Subject 1> attacks more aggressively and chases <Subject 2> into the corridor.

She throws another high kick and spinning attack.

<Subject 2> narrowly avoids the attacks.

[Shot 8] At 00:12.000, <Subject 2> uses <Subject 1>'s forward momentum to move close and initiates the fourth brief cheek kiss.

**<Subject 1> immediately tries to pull away. She turns her face aside, keeps her lips closed, raises her hand against <Subject 2>, and visibly rejects his advance. She must not make any kissing gesture or lean toward him.**

The camera smoothly pushes in to show <Subject 2>'s kiss and <Subject 1>'s rejecting reaction.

<Subject 1> says: <d>[Korean] 너 진짜...</d>

She immediately resumes chasing him.

[Shot 9] At 00:13.000, <Subject 2> barely avoids another attack, turns quickly, and initiates the fifth brief cheek kiss.

**Again, <Subject 1> clearly rejects him: closed mouth, head turning away, slight backward recoil, annoyed expression, and a hand pushing him away. She never kisses him and never reciprocates the gesture.**

After the kiss, <Subject 2> immediately turns and runs away.

He has a guilty, sheepish expression as if realizing he went too far.

[Shot 10] At 00:13.500, the chase direction reverses completely.

**<Subject 1> runs in front. <Subject 2> runs behind her and chases her from the rear.**

There is a clearly visible front-and-back distance between them.

They must not run side by side, parallel, shoulder-to-shoulder, or together in the same formation.

The camera follows the chase from behind and slightly to the side, clearly showing <Subject 1> ahead and <Subject 2> pursuing her from behind.

While chasing her, <Subject 2> says: <d>[Korean] 미안!</d>

End on <Subject 2> chasing <Subject 1> down the corridor.

### overall_soundscape

Naturalistic nighttime penthouse ambience with city ambience, footsteps, clothing movement, rapid body movement, impacts, and synchronized action sounds.

Each brief cheek kiss has a subtle natural kiss sound synchronized with the visible action.

Include subtle physical sounds of <Subject 1> recoiling, turning away, and pushing <Subject 2> away during the kiss beats.

The final chase has clearly separated footsteps, with <Subject 1>'s footsteps ahead and <Subject 2>'s footsteps following behind.

Dialogue remains synchronized with the characters' visible speaking actions.

### non_diegetic_music

Fast cinematic action-comedy background music with playful rhythmic energy.

The score emphasizes the five kiss beats as comedic punctuation and builds toward the final chase.

The ending feels playful and mischievous rather than threatening.
